company.name: Cheqout
company.shortDescription: Cheqout is a mobile ordering and payments platform for brick-and-mortar businesses.
company.description:
Cheqout is a mobile POS for brick and mortar businesses that allows waiters and retail workers to take or accept orders and payments. They can think of it as a hybrid of the Apple Store and WeChat Pay, with both staff and customers using their own devices to facilitate the transaction through QR codes. It enables their guests to order from their own devices seamlessly or simply allow them to browse the menu.

Cheqout was founded by David Rincon-Cruz, Jamie Sunderland, and Tom Sharon in 2020.
